title: The Strand Theatre

services.name: Events and Rentals
services.desc: Rent out The Strand for a glamorous backdrop to your wedding, party, corporate event, photo shoot, and more. The Friends of The Strand hold the liquor license for the Earl and Rachel Smith Strand Theatre and are the sole providers of alcoholic beverage service for all events. In the absence of alcoholic beverage service, caterers are invited to provide non-alcoholic beverage service. Over years of hosting events, we’ve cultivated a list of vendors that go above and beyond to make every event a success.
